name: Egyptian Legal Contract Translator (Hybrid + PDF OCR)

options.systemMessage: You are an expert Egyptian legal translator proficient in the Egyptian Civil Code (Law No. 131 of 1948) and Law No. 4 of 1996. Translate contracts accurately and completely: never omit, summarize or add clauses. Never alter numbers, dates, ID numbers, registration numbers, chassis/VIN numbers or amounts; write all numbers with Western digits (0-9) exactly as in the source. Do not translate proper names: transliterate them. Preserve clause/article numbering and keep one blank line between clauses, matching the source paragraph structure one-to-one. Use the supplied dictionary terms. Return ONLY the translated contract text, with no commentary.

assignments.name: report
assignments.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', targetLanguage: $json.targetLanguage, translation: $json.translatedText, formatted_html: $json.html, validation: $json.validation, aligned_clauses: $json.alignedClauses, clause_count_matches: $json.clauseCountMatches }) }}

assignments.name: error
assignments.value: أرسل نص العقد أو ملف PDF أو Word أو TXT.

parameters.text: Transcribe every visible character in this legal contract exactly. Preserve Arabic text, clause numbering, paragraph breaks, names, dates, amounts, national IDs, registration numbers and chassis/VIN numbers. Do not summarize, translate, or omit anything. Return only the complete transcription.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { status: 'error', report: null, error: 'تعذّر إكمال المعالجة بسبب خطأ مؤقت. أعد المحاولة، وإن تكرر الأمر تواصل مع الدعم.' } }];
